customer_message: hey my files have been stuck on 'syncing' for like 2 hours now and its really annoying, i need them for a meeting in an hour!!
agent_reply: Hi there, I completely understand the urgency -- let's get this sorted before your meeting. Could you try right-clicking the CloudSync tray icon and choosing 'Restart Sync'? That clears the most common cause of a stuck sync. If it's still stuck after that, open Settings > Sync Log and let me know if you see an error code there, and I'll dig in right away.

customer_message: I was charged twice this month, can I get one of those refunded?
agent_reply: Sorry about that, and thanks for flagging it. I can see the duplicate charge on your account -- I've gone ahead and refunded the extra charge to your original payment method. It should appear back on your statement within 5-10 business days. Let me know if it doesn't show up by then and I'll follow up with our payments team directly.

customer_message: why do I have a bunch of weird files called 'report (conflicted copy...)' in my folder now, did something break??
agent_reply: Good news -- nothing's broken! Those 'conflicted copy' files show up when the same file gets edited on two devices before they've had a chance to sync with each other. Rather than overwrite anyone's work, CloudSync keeps both versions and renames one so you don't lose anything. Take a look at both copies, keep whichever changes you want, and delete the one you don't need. Happy to help you compare them if you'd like.

customer_message: lost my phone with my authenticator app on it, now I can't log in because of 2FA. please just turn it off
agent_reply: Sorry to hear about your phone -- let's get you back in safely. Since this involves account security, I'll need to verify your identity first: can you confirm the email address on the account and reply from that inbox? Once that's confirmed, I can disable 2FA so you can log back in and set it up again on a new device.

customer_message: cancelled my plan by accident last week, are my files gone?
agent_reply: No need to worry -- your files are safe. We keep everything in a recoverable state for 30 days after cancellation specifically for situations like this. I can reactivate your plan right now if you'd like your files and account back exactly as they were -- just confirm and I'll take care of it.

customer_message: uploaded a 6gb video and it just won't sync, no error or anything, just sits there
agent_reply: That'll do it -- your current plan has a 5GB limit per file, so anything larger won't sync (unfortunately without a clear error, which we're working on improving). A couple of options: split the file, compress it, or upgrade to a plan with a higher per-file limit if you're regularly working with large video files. Let me know which direction you'd like to go and I can help.

customer_message: can I share a folder with someone who doesn't have CloudSync? they're a contractor, not on our team
agent_reply: Yes, that works fine -- right-click the folder, choose Share > Invite people, and enter their email. They'll get access without needing to create a CloudSync account, unless your workspace admin has external sharing turned off. If you'd like, you can also set the link to expire after their contract ends so access closes automatically.

customer_message: my phone app isnt showing the files I just added from my laptop
agent_reply: That's usually just the mobile app's cache -- try pulling down on the file list to refresh, or fully closing and reopening the app. Also worth double-checking the phone is signed into the same workspace as your laptop. If the files still don't show up after that, let me know and we'll look closer.
